title: Why are European countries moving their gold out of North America?

title: Fyodor Lukyanov: Here’s why it’s hard for Witkoff and Kushner to close the Russia-Ukraine deal
summary:
But why, then, does Trump’s diplomatic initiative keep going round in circles, with each new attempt ending in another disappointment?
Given the professional backgrounds of the president and his two principal intermediaries, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, this is hardly surprising.
Nor would abandoning Ukraine enjoy much support across the American political establishment, where there is virtually no constituency for a fundamental rapprochement with Russia.
Also, informal channels can help restore understanding where formal diplomacy has broken down, but informal diplomacy has limits.
Friends and business associates may establish contacts and discover areas in which compromise is conceivable, but they don’t themselves make peace.
